name: Sri Lanka
famous_for: Sigiriya rock fortress ('Lion Rock'), Ceylon black tea plantations, blue whales of Mirissa, and scenic Kandy-to-Ella train ride.
tourists: Over 1.5M international visitors; famous for Sigiriya, Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Yala leopard safari, and Galle Fort.
must_know: A gentle side-to-side head wobble in Sri Lanka is a warm, affirmative gesture conveying 'yes', understanding, and agreement.
fun_fact: Sri Lanka was the first nation in modern world history to elect a female Prime Minister: Sirimavo Bandaranaike in 1960.
